user.title: Input devices
user.description: Found {count} keyboard-like input device(s) ({virtual} virtual). Enabled devices are grabbed: their keys go to Home Assistant only, not to the host console or desktop. Every listed device gets entities; unselected ones start disabled.

data_description.enabled_devices: Devices to grab and turn into events. Do not enable the only keyboard of this host.
data_description.include_virtual: uinput devices such as keyd, kanata or ydotool outputs. Off by default to avoid feedback loops.

error.no_input: No /dev/input/event* nodes. Map /dev/input into the Home Assistant container (see the README), then submit to retry.
error.permission_denied: /dev/input/event* exists but none can be opened. Give Home Assistant read-write access (input group or a udev rule), then submit to retry.
error.no_devices: No keyboard-like devices found. Submit to set up anyway; devices plugged in later appear disabled.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Already configured. Only a single configuration possible.

data_description.rescan_interval: Hotplug scan period in seconds. 0 disables hotplug.
data_description.new_devices_enabled: Grab newly seen devices immediately. Off is safer: a new keyboard on this host would otherwise stop typing locally.
data_description.mqtt_mirror: Also publish each event to <base topic>/<device id>/event, same payload as the evmqtt daemon.
data_description.mqtt_base_topic: Base topic for the MQTT mirror.

error.keystates_required: Select at least one key state.
